calls.reason: The firm part, that AGI arrives eventually, has no deadline, and the century timing is hedged. ARC Prize's Astra report and the AGI Society review both stop short of calling any system AGI.
The 2022 NLP survey only shows a split on whether models understand language. Ford's Argo write-down is one company's step back. Neither measures how widely the AI community held either belief.

Research from January 2023 (the WBAI New Year note, DreamerV3 training separate agents per task) treats cross-domain integration as unsolved. Gato combined some tasks and modalities but fell short of the general understanding he described.

La Libre reported a recent Belgian suicide in March 2023, which the widow and reportedly his psychiatrist blamed on the Chai chatbot. VICE confirms the chatbot ran on a GPT-J-based LLM. Whether it was truly the first remains unproven.

The thematic-narrowing study is descriptive only and says outright it does not test causes. The compute-divide paper is about institutions losing out, not alternative ideas being displaced. It also reads as a stated concern.
CB Insights data quoted by the OECD put 2022 generative AI funding at $2.6B, against $45.8B for all AI venture funding. That is far below half, though internal corporate spending is not counted.
